Dts.title: DTS
Dts.lead: Browse DTS (Distributed Text Services) collections and open a chosen text in the viewer.
Dts.errorEntry: Could not open the entry endpoint.
Dts.errorNavigation: Could not load the citable units.
Dts.errorFetch: The network is unreachable or the server does not allow the request.
Dts.errorNotDts: The response was not DTS. Check the entry endpoint URL.

Xsl.title: XSL
Xsl.lead: Enter the URL of a TEI file to see it transformed with XSLT. Switch the stylesheet to compare how it looks.
Xsl.errorFetch: Could not fetch the TEI. Check the URL. A URL on another site cannot be read unless that site allows it.
Xsl.errorParse: Could not read it as XML.
Xsl.errorTransform: The transformation failed. Check that the chosen stylesheet suits this TEI.

GeoRef.autoRotateOnSelect: When a point is selected, turn its surroundings north up
GeoRef.placeSearchFailed: Search failed. Please wait a moment and try again

Viewer.title: Viewer
Viewer.lead: Enter the URL of a TEI file to read its text. You can switch between vertical and horizontal writing, and read several texts side by side. When the texts are linked with @corresp, clicking a passage in one highlights the matching passage in the other.
Viewer.sampleYosano: Yosano Akiko's translation of Genji, Kiritsubo (horizontal)
Viewer.sampleParallel: Kōi Genji and Yosano's translation side by side (Kiritsubo)
Viewer.sampleLinked: Eiri Genji and Yosano's translation, linked passage by passage (Kiritsubo, a PTV config.json)
Viewer.witnessDistanceNote: Bars show how far each witness differs from the lemma (sum of edit distances). Click one to read the text as that witness
Viewer.silentWitness: not named; assumed to read as the lemma
Viewer.errorFetch: Could not fetch the TEI. Check the URL, and that the server allows cross-origin requests (CORS).
Viewer.errorParse: Could not parse the file as XML.
Viewer.errorNotTei: This does not look like TEI (the root element is {root}).
Viewer.errorConfig: This config.json has no text URL (url_main).
Viewer.addLabel: URL of a TEI file to add
